info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Account Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Account Management Retrieval API allows users to access detailed account management information using specific parameters. Designed for banking and financial service applications, this endpoint retrieves transaction data related to a user's account. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, account managers, and developers building client-facing banking applications. This API facilitates efficient management of account-related transactions based on the given parameter, streamlining access to essential account information.

get.summary: Retrieve transaction details by resource ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the details of a specific transaction using its unique resource identifier. It is designed to provide comprehensive information related to the transaction, enabling users to understand its context and status.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving transaction details associated with the specified account management transaction engine. This request is designed to fetch operations data for the transaction identified by the given resource identifier.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested transaction details.

GetAccountManagementByParam1Request.description: Request body for the GET operation in the transaction engine for account management.

GetAccountManagementByParam1Response_200.title: Transaction Response

accountId.description: The unique identifier for the account.

customerId.description: The unique identifier for the customer associated with the account.

ledgerDate.description: The date of the ledger entry.

currency.description: The currency type for the account balance.

ledgerBalance.description: The current balance of the ledger.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the record was last updated.

GetAccountManagementByParam1Response_200.description: This schema represents the response for the transaction operation, containing details about the account and its balance.

TransactionMetadata.title: Transaction Metadata

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation identifier for tracking the transaction across systems.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the transaction was processed.

TransactionMetadata.description: This schema represents the metadata associated with the transaction response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request, allowing for tracking and analysis.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that is currently running and processing the request, useful for identifying the source of the response.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, allowing clients to exchange JSON Web Tokens (JWT) as a means of authentication. Include the token in the Authorization header as: 'Authorization: Bearer {token}'.
